description: Hexagon socket head cap screw per ISO 4762: a cylindrical head (diameter dk, height k jointly locked to the nominal thread size) with a recessed hexagon drive socket and a chamfer on the head top edge; a fillet under the head where it meets the shank; and a shank carrying a modelled external metric thread (ISO 261 coarse pitch) rendered as a single-start helical V-groove over the tip length b = 2d + 12, leaving a plain grip under the head, with a 45-degree lead-in chamfer at the threaded end.
source: ISO 4762 head diameter dk, head height k, socket width s table; ISO 261 coarse pitch; ISO 4753 chamfered thread end
